items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: he said, "Man, he's terrific; I'm going to get that man." And he got him; he took him with him, then.

ctx.x: Jimmy Blanton -- I went to see him, we was in St. Louis, and I went to see Jimmy Blanton once, because he was a fellow who used to take his bass and play with anybody, you know? In this particular cabaret, I went there and listened to him, and he was playing Sophisticated Lady with a bow, you know? And he did so many good things in there, I go out of the club there and ran over to the hotel where we and Duke were staying, too, and I said, "Duke, you got to get up and come with me and let's go and see this bass…
And he did -- he came over there, and he said, "Man, he's terrific; I'm going to get that man." And he got him; he took him with him, then.
And I guess he was a pretty nice person, guy, huh?
